title: Minimal time for null controllability of the parabolic spherical Baouendi-Grushin equation
summary: We study null controllability for the parabolic equation on $\mathbb{S}^{2}$ endowed with its canonical almost-Riemannian structure. For a spherical crown $ω=\{α<x_3<β\}$, where $0\le α<β\le1$, we prove the sharp minimal time formula $T_{\min}(ω)=\ln(1/\sqrt{1-α^{2}})$ for null controllability in $ω$. We also prove that, whenever the control region contains the equator, null controllability holds in every positive time. The proof combines two complementary tools.
